active_question: A cloud is above a lake. From an observation point h metres above the lake, the angle of elevation of the cloud is α and the angle of depression of its reflection in the lake is β, where 0° < α < β < 90°. What is the height of the cloud above the lake surface?

review_note: From tan α=(H−h)/d and tan β=(H+h)/d, elimination gives H=h(tan β+tan α)/(tan β−tan α). Given β>α, the denominator is positive. Option C (index 2) is correct.
